commentary.bulkers: E Nomikos have committed the Kamsarmax "Epiphania" 80/2012 Stx, Korea (SS/DD 02/2027) at USD 17,5 mill. Remind you that earlier this month, the "Athina Carras" 82/2012 Daewoo, Korea (SS/DD 02/2027) was sold at the same price. The Ultramax "Only You" 60/2017 Sanoyas, Japan (SS/DD 01/2027) of Alpha Omega Ship Management was committed to Danish interests at USD 28,5 mill. Note that the vessel had been acquired back in July as ex-IVS Swinley Forest from Taylor Maritime at USD 23,3 mill. On the Supramax sector, Hermes Maritime Services committed the "Asian Pearl" 50/2003 Kawasaki, Japan (SS/DD 03/2026) to undisclosed interests at USD 7,7 mill. For comparison, the one-year-older "Oasis Champion" 50/2002 Mitsui, Japan (SS/DD 07/2027) was committed a week ago at USD 7,5 mill. Ciner Ship Management have committed the Handysize "Zafer" 35/2011 Samho, Korea (SS/DD 03/2026) at low-mid USD 13 mill. Note that the one- year-younger "Jetstream" 34/2012 Spp, Korea (SS/DD 05/2027) was sold a month ago at USD 13,5 mill. Moreover, the "Adventure" 33/2011 Samjin, China (SS/DD 03/2026) of Alfa Shipping was committed to Greek interests at USD 9,5 mill. Remind you that back in December, the one-year-younger sister vessel "Sepetiba Bay" 35/2012 Samjin, China (SS/DD 06/2027) was sold at USD 11,3 mill.
commentary.tankers: Following the sale of the "Eagle Varna" 300/2013 Daewoo, Korea (SS 03/2028, DD 03/2026) earlier this month, clients of AET have also committed the sister vessel "Eagle Vancouver" 300/2013 Daewoo, Korea (SS 01/2028, DD 04/2026) to clients of Sinokor at the same price, i.e. USD 86,5 mill. Performance Shipping have committed their Aframax "P. Sophia" 105/2009 Hyundai, Korea (SS 09/2029, DD 11/2027) at USD 35,65 mill. For reference, the Japanese built "Ionic Artemis" 107/2009 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 09/2029, DD 09/2027) was sold a month ago at USD 35,5 mill. The MR2 "Hansa Tromsoe" 51/2008 Stx, Korea (SS 07/2028, DD 07/2026) of Leonhardt & Blumberg was committed at USD 16,9 mill. Note that earlier this month, the sister vessel "Lysias" 50/2008 Stx, Korea (SS 07/2028, DD 07/2026) was sold at USD 16,5 mill. In addition, the one-year-younger "Romance" 50/2009 Sls, Korea (SS 01/2029, DD 04/2027) was committed at rgn USD 16 mill.
